leadText: Toru Sakurai (Japanese: 櫻井トオル Toru Sakurai) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Toru Sakurai (Japanese: 櫻井トオル Toru Sakurai) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Sakurai was born on November 10, 1987 in , . He joined the during and voiced a number of characters during that time, with his most important role being Gladion's Silvally. He also replaced Takaaki Uchino as recurring Tupp, starting in SM024. Sakurai is currently affiliated with Ken Production.
